line: Wait. You two are the strangers?
note: Quick, thrown, a bit too loud for a restaurant.

line: Nio, we came here to get away from you.
note: Quick and dry, not even looking up.

line: It says dinner with strangers. Right here on my app.
note: Quick, defensive, holding up his phone.

line: Hi, I'm Theo. I have never met you in my life.
note: Bright and fake, like meeting someone at a party.

line: Theo, you owe me two months of rent.
See, a stranger would never bring that up.
Fine. We're all new here. Hi, I'm Maya.
note: Quick, giving up, then a big fake smile.

line: I'm Nio. I built the app that did this to us.
note: Quick and proud, then hearing himself.

line: Oh my god. Look. An actual stranger.
note: A fast excited whisper, like spotting a celebrity.
